label: v1.4.0 (current)
notes: Rebuilt crash screen that restores the VGA font and palette before printing (no more garbled fault screen) with a 5 second countdown and three reset paths. Leaving the GUI no longer corrupts the text console. Enter/Backspace/Tab/Esc scancodes fixed. 21 keyboard layouts with Alt+Shift, 'keymap list|next|<id>'. Terminal editor 'edit' and pager 'less'. Intel PRO/1000 (e1000) driver for VirtualBox alongside RTL8139 and PCnet. New gradient MINIMAL OS boot wordmark. 'minipacket -L' package listing. Disk installer: `install` streams the isohybrid image to the first ATA disk; boot splash rebuilt from your original ANSI art.

label: v1.3.0
notes: AMD PCnet driver for VirtualBox/QEMU virtual NICs (DHCP + selftest now pass in VirtualBox), clickable network-connector buttons, ANSI-art boot banner, keyboard/console/palette stability fixes, plus all v1.1/v1.2 features (Miniland, enhanced DOOM, rendered GUI, hwinfo).

label: v1.2.0
notes: Crash diagnostics, Super-key start menu, movable Miniland windows, enhanced DOOM, rendered GUI, GUI network connector, hwinfo detection.
